<translated_code>
import math
import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    if n > 11:
        print("0")
        return
    pts = []
    index = 1
    for _ in range(n):
        v, w, x, y, z = map(int, input_data[index:index+5])
        index += 5
        pts.append(Point(v, w, x, y, z))
    result = []
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        good = True
        for j in range(n):
            for k in range(n):
                if i != j and i != k and j != k:
                    one = pts[j]
                    two = pts[k]
                    three = pts[i]
                    lol2 = Point(one.v - three.v, one.w - three.w, one.x - three.x, one.y - three.y, one.z - three.z)
                    lol1 = Point(two.v - three.v, two.w - three.w, two.x - three.x, two.y - three.y, two.z - three.z)
                    if angle(lol1, lol2):
                        good = False
        if good:
            count += 1
            result.append(str(i + 1))
    if count == 0:
        print(0)
    else:
        print(count)
        print("\n".join(result))

def angle(a, b):
    amag = a.mag()
    bmag = b.mag()
    dot = a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
    # To avoid floating point errors, clamp the value between -1 and 1
    val = dot / (amag * bmag) if amag != 0 and bmag != 0 else 1
    val = max(min(val, 1), -1)
    return math.degrees(math.acos(val)) < 90

class Point:
    def __init__(self, v, w, x, y, z):
        self.v = v
        self.w = w
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.z = z

    def mag(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.v * self.v + self.w * self.w + self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y + self.z * self.z)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
